en: A black‑and‑white postcard showing a vaulted stone interior, likely a crypt or basement of a large historic building. Massive barrel and cross vaults rest on thick piers with a heavy masonry base. Light enters through a large round-arched window with a grid of small panes on the right. On the left, a staircase leads upward. Near the center is a small shrine or arrangement with plants, beside which a person sits or kneels, emphasizing the religious or contemplative character of the space.
